turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Priya. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, it's been three weeks since I made a claim and nobody has called me back. I'm really frustrated and I want to make a complaint.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Kwame Mensah, 9 April 1979.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've been waiting weeks for an update on your claim and you'd like to complain. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry about the delay. I can log a formal complaint, which we acknowledge within 3 working days, or arrange for a supervisor to call you back within 24 hours. Which would you prefer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A supervisor callback, please.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you tell me roughly when you made the claim?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About three weeks ago.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will I get some compensation for this?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise a particular outcome, but your complaint will be looked at properly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Claims are normally acknowledged within 24 hours and assessed within 10 working days once we have all the documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Mensah. I've logged this under reference REQ-50337, and our claims team will contact you with an update.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your complaint and chased your claim.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
